column2: The shining Sun, Aditya, not light but the imperishable; they drip honey, that essence. Truth is that essence: the waters, light, essence, immortality, Brahman; Bhur Bhuvah Svah. Om.

May Brahman come to me. May honey come to me. May Brahman and honey come to me. The offspring that are yours, Soma — I am their calf. Destroyer of bad dreams, hard to endure, the breaths that are yours, Soma, I offer.

One should give the Trisuparna, unasked, to a Brahmin. These indeed destroy the sin of killing a Brahmin: the Brahmins who recite the Trisuparna. They attain soma; they purify a row up to a thousand. Om.
Brahman with insight. Honey with insight. Brahman and honey with insight.
Today, O god Savitar, bring us good fortune with offspring; drive away the bad dream.
O god Savitar, drive away all evils; whatever is good, bring that to me.
The winds blow honey for the lawful; the rivers flow honey; may the plants be honey to us.
Honey by night and at dawn; honey the dust of the earth; may heaven our father be honey to us.
May the forest tree be honeyed for us; may the Sun be honeyed; may the cows be honeyed for us.

Whoever would give this Trisuparna, unasked, to a Brahmin — these indeed destroy the sin of killing an embryo: the Brahmins who recite the Trisuparna. They attain soma; they purify a row up to a thousand. Om.
Brahman with wisdom. Honey with wisdom. Brahman and honey with wisdom.
Brahma of the gods, the leader of seers, the sage of the wise, the buffalo of beasts, the falcon of vultures, the axe of woods — Soma crosses the filter roaring.

The swan dwelling in purity, the Vasu in the air, the priest at the altar, the guest in the house; dwelling among men, in the best, in truth, in the sky, born of water, of cattle, of truth, of mountain — the great truth.
For the verse I take you; for the verse I take you. The streams flow together like milch-cows, purified within by heart and mind; I look upon the streams of ghee.
A golden reed in the midst of them; on it the fair-winged honey-maker, nesting, enjoys honey for the deities. On its bank sit seven bay ones, milking the offering, the stream of immortality.

Whoever would give this Trisuparna, unasked, to a Brahmin — these indeed destroy the sin of killing a hero: the Brahmins who recite the Trisuparna. They attain soma; they purify a row up to a thousand. Om.
May the goddess Medha, well pleased, come to us, all-pervading, auspicious, gracious; enjoyed by you, may we speak greatly at the gathering, rich in heroes.
Enjoyed by you, O goddess, one becomes a sage; by you a Brahmin attains glory; enjoyed by you one finds wondrous wealth; accept us with riches, O Medha.
May Indra give me insight; may the goddess Sarasvati give me insight; may the two Ashvins, wearing lotus garlands, place insight in me.
The insight that is among the Apsarases and the mind among the Gandharvas, the divine insight, Sarasvati — may that fragrant Medha accept me, svaha.
May that fragrant Medha of all forms, golden-colored, of the world, to be reached, strong, swelling with milk, well-faced, accept me.
In me insight, in me offspring; may Agni place radiance in me. In me insight, in me offspring; may Indra place vigor in me. In me insight, in me offspring; may the Sun place splendor in me.
May death depart; may immortality come to us; may Vaivasvata make us fearless. As the leaf of a tree falls away, may wealth fall to us; may the lord of powers be with us.
Go away, Death, by another path, which is yours apart from the path of the gods. I speak to you who see and hear: do not harm our offspring nor our heroes.
We take hold, with the mind, of Vata and Prana, of Prajapati, the guardian of the world. May he save us from death and protect us from distress; may we live long and attain old age.
May it be there, then, if Yama's — Brihaspati, you freed from curse. May the Ashvins, physicians of the gods, Agni, with their powers drive death away from us.
The gods follow the bay one who takes away, the ruler of all, the bull of thoughts; the form of Brahman has come after the fat; do not hinder the going; stride forth.
Kindling Agni with chips, may I win both worlds; in both worlds I prosper; may I cross death.
Do not cut me off, Death; do not slay me; do not take away my strength; do not rob me. Do not harm my offspring, fierce one; we serve you, who watch men, with offering.
Do not harm our great one nor our small, nor our growing nor our grown; do not slay our father or mother; do not harm our dear bodies, Rudra.
Do not harm us in our children and grandchildren, nor in our life, nor in our cattle, nor in our horses; do not slay our heroes in anger, Rudra; with offerings we serve you with homage.
Prajapati, none other than you has embraced all these things born; whatever we desire in offering to you, let that be ours; may we be lords of wealth.
Giver of welfare, lord of the clans, Vritra-slayer, subduer of enemies, master — may bull Indra go before us, giver of welfare, maker of fearlessness.
The thousand fetters of yours, Death, for the slaying of mortals — all those we undo by the magic of the sacrifice.
To Death, svaha; to Death, svaha.

You are the expiation of sin done by gods, svaha. You are the expiation of sin done by men, svaha. You are the expiation of sin done by fathers, svaha. You are the expiation of sin done by oneself, svaha. You are the expiation of sin done by others, svaha. You are the expiation of sin done by us, svaha. Of whatever sin we have done by day and night, you are the expiation, svaha. Of whatever sin we have done sleeping and waking, you are the expiation, svaha. Of whatever sin we have done asleep and awake, you are the expiation, svaha. Of whatever sin we have done knowing and not knowing, you are the expiation, svaha. Of sin after sin you are the expiation, svaha.
Whatever offense against the gods we have committed by tongue, whatever grave by mind or impulse; he who plots evil against us without cause — place that sin upon him, O Vasus, svaha.
Desire did it; homage, homage. Desire did it; desire does; I do not do; desire is the doer, not I; desire is the causer, not I. This is yours, Desire, for Desire, svaha.
Anger did it; homage, homage. Anger did it; anger does; I do not do; anger is the doer, not I; anger is the causer, not I. This is yours, Anger, for Anger, svaha.
I offer sesame seeds, juicy and with ground meal; may they delight my mind, O Gandhara, svaha.
Cattle, gold, wealth, food and drink — for the glory of all, svaha.
Glory, Lakshmi, nourishment, fame, freedom from debt, Brahminhood, many sons — may Faith and Insight give us offspring, svaha.
Black sesame, white sesame, gentle sesame, obedient sesame — may the sesame purify my sin, whatever evil is in me, svaha.
Food of a thief, the first funerary rite, the Brahmin-killer, the violator of a teacher's bed, cattle-theft, drinking liquor, killing an embryo — may sesame quell these with peace, svaha.
May Shri, Lakshmi, nourishment, fame, freedom from debt, Brahminhood, many sons, faith, insight and wisdom be given by Jatavedas, svaha.
May my prana, apana, vyana, udana and samana be purified; may I be light, free of dust, free of sin, svaha.
May my speech, mind, eye, ear, tongue, nose, seed, intellect, intention and resolve be purified; may I be light, free of dust, free of sin, svaha.
May my skin, hide, flesh, blood, fat, marrow, sinews and bones be purified; may I be light, free of dust, free of sin, svaha.
May my head, hands, feet, sides, back, thighs, belly, shanks, organ, generative and excretory organs be purified; may I be light, free of dust, free of sin, svaha.
Arise, Person, green, tawny, red-eyed; give, give, causer of giving; may I be purified; may I be light, free of dust, free of sin, svaha.
May my earth, water, fire, air and space be purified; may I be light, free of dust, free of sin, svaha.
May my sound, touch, form, taste and smell be purified; may I be light, free of dust, free of sin, svaha.
May my mind, speech, body and actions be purified; may I be light, free of dust, free of sin, svaha.
By unmanifest states and egoisms — may I be light, free of dust, free of sin, svaha.
May my Self be purified; may I be light, free of dust, free of sin, svaha.
May my inner Self be purified; may I be light, free of dust, free of sin, svaha.
May my Supreme Self be purified; may I be light, free of dust, free of sin, svaha.
To hunger, svaha. To hunger and thirst, svaha. To Vivitti, svaha. To Rigvidhana, svaha. To Kashotka, svaha. Om, svaha.
I destroy the stain of hunger and thirst, the eldest, and Alakshmi; drive from me ill fortune, non-prosperity and all sin, svaha.
May my Self, made of food, breath, mind, knowledge and bliss, be purified; may I be light, free of dust, free of sin, svaha.

To Agni, svaha. To all the gods, svaha. To the firm earth, svaha. To the firm dweller, svaha. To the undying dweller, svaha. To Agni Svishtakrit, svaha. To dharma, svaha. To adharma, svaha. To the waters, svaha. To plants and trees, svaha. To the demons, gods and people, svaha. To the household ones, svaha. To the boundaries, svaha. To the lords of the boundaries, svaha. To all beings, svaha. To desire, svaha. To the air, svaha. Whatever moves in the world and whatever stirs — this is the share of the name, to the name, svaha. To earth, svaha. To air, svaha. To heaven, svaha. To the Sun, svaha. To the Moon, svaha. To the stars, svaha. To Indra, svaha. To Brihaspati, svaha. To Prajapati, svaha. To Brahma, svaha. Svadha to the fathers, svaha. Homage to Rudra, lord of beasts, svaha. To the gods, svaha. To the fathers, svadha. Homage to beings. To men, hanta. To Prajapati, svaha. To Parameshthi, svaha.
As a well of a hundred streams, of a thousand streams, is unfailing, so may my grain be of a thousand streams, unfailing. To wealth and grain, svaha.
The beings who roam day and night desiring an offering, servants of Vitudu — to them I bring the offering, desiring nourishment; may the lord of nourishment place nourishment in me, svaha.
Om, that is Brahman. Om, that is Vayu. Om, that is the Self. Om, that is truth. Om, that is all. Om, that is before; homage.

Om. You move within beings, in the cave, in all forms. You are sacrifice, you are the vashat call, you are Indra, you are Rudra, you are Vishnu, you are Brahman, you are Prajapati. You are that, the waters, light, essence, immortality, Brahman; Bhur Bhuvah Svah. Om.

Established in faith in the prana, I offer immortality. Established in faith in the apana, I offer immortality. Established in faith in the vyana, I offer immortality. Established in faith in the udana, I offer immortality. Established in faith in the samana, I offer immortality. My Self is in Brahman for immortality.
You are the spreading-cover of immortality.

Established in faith in the prana, I offer immortality; be auspicious to me, enter me not for burning; to prana, svaha. Established in faith in the apana, I offer immortality; be auspicious, enter me not for burning; to apana, svaha. Established in faith in the vyana, I offer immortality; be auspicious, enter me not for burning; to vyana, svaha. Established in faith in the udana, I offer immortality; be auspicious, enter me not for burning; to udana, svaha. Established in faith in the samana, I offer immortality; be auspicious, enter me not for burning; to samana, svaha. My Self is in Brahman for immortality.
You are the covering of immortality.
The Person of thumb size, resting on the thumb, lord of all the world, master — may the all-enjoyer be pleased.

Speech was in my mouth; breath in my nostrils; sight in my eyes; hearing in my ears; strength in my arms; vigor in my thighs; unharmed all my limbs and body; with my body, homage to you; do not harm me.
The birds, the fair-winged, the sages of dear wisdom, sat near Indra, begging; drive away the darkness, fill the eye, free us who are bound as with a snare.
You are the knot of the breaths; Rudra, the ender, do not enter me; by that food be satisfied.
Homage to Rudra and Vishnu; Death, protect me.
You, Agni, are born pure, by days; you, the swift-flaming; you from the waters; you from the stones; you from the woods, you from the plants; you, lord of men.

Be united with me by the auspicious; be united with me by the kind; be united with me by Brahmanical splendor; be united with me following the prosperity of the sacrifice. Homage to you, sacrifice; homage to you; homage to you.
Truth is the highest; the highest is truth. By truth they never fall from the heavenly world; truth belongs to the good; therefore they delight in truth.
Austerity — "austerity" — there is nothing higher than fasting; for what is the highest austerity is unassailable and hard to overcome; therefore they delight in austerity.
Self-control — "self-control" — the students of Brahman are restrained; therefore they delight in self-control.
Calm — "calm" — sages in the forest; therefore they delight in calm.
Giving — "giving" — all beings praise; nothing is harder than giving; therefore they delight in giving.
Dharma — "dharma" — all this is upheld by dharma; nothing is harder to practice than dharma; therefore they delight in dharma.
Procreation — "procreation" — more are born therefrom; therefore they delight in procreation.
Fires, he said; therefore the fires are to be established.
Agnihotra, he said; therefore they delight in Agnihotra.
Sacrifice — "sacrifice" — by sacrifice the gods went to heaven; therefore they delight in sacrifice.
Mental, the wise say; therefore the wise delight in the mental.
Renunciation: Brahma is Brahman, for Brahman is supreme; these are the lower austerities; renunciation alone surpasses them — for him who knows thus. Thus the Upanishad.
Prajapati's son Aruni Suparneya approached his father Prajapati: "What do the revered ones call supreme?" He told him:
By truth the wind blows; by truth the sun shines in heaven; truth is the foundation of speech; in truth all is established; therefore they call truth supreme.

By austerity the gods first attained divinity; by austerity the seers found heaven; by austerity we drive away rivals and enemies; in austerity all is established; therefore they call austerity supreme.

By self-control the self-controlled shake off sin; by self-control the students of Brahman went to heaven; self-control is hard for beings to overcome; in self-control all is established; therefore they call self-control supreme.
By calm the calm practice the auspicious; by calm the sages found heaven; calm is hard for beings to overcome; in calm all is established; therefore they call calm supreme.

Giving is the shelter of sacrifices; the fee in the world; all beings live on the giver; by giving they drive away enemies; by giving haters become friends; in giving all is established; therefore they call giving supreme.
Dharma is the foundation of the whole world; in the world people approach the most righteous; by dharma one drives away sin; in dharma all is established; therefore they call dharma supreme.
Procreation is the foundation in the world; extending the thread of offspring, one becomes free of debt to the fathers; that is his freedom from debt; therefore they call procreation supreme.

The fires are the threefold knowledge, the path of the gods; the Garhapatya is the Rik, the earth, the Rathantara; the Anvaharyapachana; the Yajus, the air, the Vamadevya, the Ahavaniya; the Saman, the heavenly world, the Brihat; therefore they call the fires supreme.
The Agnihotra evening and morning is the atonement for households; well-offered, well-poured, the way of sacrificial rites, the light of the heavenly world; therefore they call Agnihotra supreme.

Sacrifice — "sacrifice" — sacrifice is of the gods; by sacrifice the gods went to heaven; by sacrifice they drove away the Asuras; by sacrifice haters become friends; in sacrifice all is established; therefore they call sacrifice supreme.
The mental is Prajapati's, pure; by the mind one sees well; the seers created offspring; in the mental all is established; therefore they call the mental supreme.
Renunciation, the wise say: Brahma is Brahman; Brahma is the universe; which one? The self-existent Prajapati, the year.
The year is that Aditya; the Person in that Aditya is Parameshthi, the Self of Brahman.

By the rays by which Aditya shines, by them Parjanya rains; by Parjanya the plants and trees are born; from plants and trees comes food; from food the breaths; from the breaths strength; from strength austerity; from austerity faith; from faith insight; from insight thought; from thought mind; from mind peace; from peace the heart; from the heart memory; from memory recollection; from recollection knowledge; by knowledge one knows the Self; therefore giving food one gives all these; from food the breaths of beings; from breaths mind; from mind knowledge; from knowledge bliss, Brahman the source.

This Person is fivefold, five-natured, by whom all this is woven: earth, air, heaven, directions and intermediate directions; he is all this world, he is the past and future, desired by the seeker, born of truth, rich in wealth, faith, truth, beyond darkness. Knowing him thus by mind and heart, a knower does not again approach death. Therefore they say renunciation exceeds these austerities.

You are the Vasu, subtle, all-pervading; in the breath you are the joiner; O Brahman, you are the world-creator; you are the giver of radiance, of Agni; you are the giver of splendor of the Sun; you are the giver of the Moon; you are taken with a pledge; for Brahman, for greatness I take you.
With Om one should yoke the Self. This is the secret of the gods, the Mahopanishad. He who knows thus attains the greatness of Brahman; therefore the greatness of Brahman — thus the Upanishad.
